label_source: Synthetic faults injected by Data Cleaning notebook; not verified human fault annotations
limitations: Original deployed model uses random split; its shuffled CV imputation was fitted before folds.
Chronological diagnostic refits a separate model; original hyperparameters came from prior random-split search, so this is not a blind external validation.
Soiling injection modifies a full day while labelling only ten rows. Synthetic labels are incomplete.
SHAP explains model scores, not a physical fault diagnosis; probabilities are uncalibrated.
Global SHAP uses the first 512 rows of the deterministic shuffled test split.
